I posted these questions earlier  but I can't seem to find them, 
so I'll try again. (I think I posted on .marketplace accidently)


The Renegade Garou does 2 damage and has an addition strike. Does this 
mean it can effectively do 4 damage in one combat round ???

Also, can allies be equipped with equipment cards, or use combat cards
 that require no discipline, such as dodge?


If I take blood off of a protracted investment, is that my master turn, or
can I also play a master card in the same round?

If true, does this also apply for Zoo Hunting ground, which does its effect
during Untap phase?? And how about Art Museum?

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
<l1nocell@vaxc.stevens-tech.edu> wrote:
>The Renegade Garou does 2 damage and has an addition strike. Does this 
>mean it can effectively do 4 damage in one combat round ???

Yup.

>Also, can allies be equipped with equipment cards, or use combat cards
> that require no discipline, such as dodge?

Sure.

>If I take blood off of a protracted investment, is that my master turn, or
>can I also play a master card in the same round?

You spend one master action to take a counter off an investment.  You will
thus not be able to play a master card, or take another counter off, that
turn unless you have multiple master actions (e.g. if you have Anson ready).

>If true, does this also apply for Zoo Hunting ground, which does its effect
>during Untap phase?? And how about Art Museum?

A Hunting Ground can only be used once per turn, and multiple Hunting Grounds
cannot be used to feed the same vampire on a given turn.  Art Museum taps
when used, so would be usable again if you could untap it somehow, but
there's no way to untap it during your influence phase.
